history.claim: Thung Phra Pho Public Park is located within the Takua Pa old town area, which is subject to municipal building control regulations.
history.quote: สวนสาธารณะทุ่งพระโพธิ์

history.claim: Municipal planning documents state that the park features a health garden and a playground.
history.quote: มีสวนสุขภาพ และสนามเด็กเล่น

history.claim: No online evidence has verified the year of establishment, founders, its role during the tin mining era, specific architecture, or historical registration of the park.

timeline.title: Park within the old town building control zone
timeline.detail: The Royal Gazette lists the park as an exception within the construction control boundary of Takua Pa old town.

timeline.title: Municipality manages electricity and water plans
timeline.detail: There are projects to install electrical control cabinets in the park and plans regarding the Thung Phra Pho canal or pier.

timeline.title: Checkpoint for the Old Town Walk Rally
timeline.detail: Takua Pa Khiri Khet School uses the park and the old town area as a route for cultural learning and health promotion activities.

timeline.title: Year of establishment not verified
timeline.detail: No documents directly stating the year, founders, or reasons for establishing the park have been verified.

news.title: Takua Pa Khiri Khet School participates in Takua Pa Walk Rally 2026 (2569 BE)
news.summary: The event uses Thung Phra Pho Public Park and the old town area as a walking and running route to learn about local history and culture.

history.claim: The market is named 'Takua Pa Riverside Market, Ruam Jai Pracharath' in the Must-See Pracharath Market project and is located on the canal-side road next to Wat Yan Yao.
history.quote: ถนนริมคลอง (ข้างวัดย่านยาว)

history.claim: Online tourism sources suggest the market connects with water tourism and boat tours along both sides of the Takua Pa River.
history.quote: ล่องเรือชมทิวทัศน์สองฝั่งแม่น้ำตะกั่วป่า

history.claim: Talat Yai or Takua Pa old town area was a trade center during the tin mining era and features Sino-Portuguese buildings, but no evidence has verified the year the riverside market itself was built or if it is registered as a historical site.
history.quote: ศูนย์กลางการค้าในยุคเหมืองแร่

timeline.title: Original town destroyed by the Burmese and people migrated
timeline.detail: The original Takua Pa town was destroyed and abandoned before being revived around Ban Talat Yai during the reign of King Rama III.

timeline.title: Market listed in the Must-See Market project
timeline.detail: Government documents name the Takua Pa Riverside Market, Ruam Jai Pracharath in Phang Nga province.

timeline.title: Official location and time data available
timeline.detail: The Department of Internal Trade states that the market is located on the canal-side road next to Wat Yan Yao and opens on Saturdays from 3:00 PM to 8:00 PM.

timeline.title: Takua Pa grew into a port and trade center
timeline.detail: The riverside area was the axis for navigation, goods exchange, and settlements of people from various nations.

timeline.title: Chap Se area served as an old port
timeline.detail: The name Chap Se is a Hokkien Chinese word meaning port, and is associated with the Chinese merchant community and the tin mining economy.

timeline.title: Mines gradually closed, town shifted from a mining hub to an old town
timeline.detail: Local historical sources note that prosperity from mining declined after the mines gradually closed, and the river became shallow due to mining sediment.

timeline.title: Seafood festival uses the market as a venue
timeline.detail: The Ministry of Culture's cultural calendar lists the Takua Pa Seafood Festival at the riverside market, although accessible pages do not clearly show the event dates.

nearby.name: Takua Pa old town / Talat Yai community

visit.best_time: Saturday afternoon to evening, as the market starts getting busy around 4:00 PM.

riverwalk.address_line: Sri Takua Pa Road or Canal-side Road, next to Wat Yan Yao

history.claim: Tourism news sources indicate it started in 2007 (2550 BE) under the name 'Takua Pa Old Town, Telling the Past'.
history.quote: มีมาตั้งแต่ปี พ.ศ. 2550

history.claim: The Department of Internal Trade's market registry lists its establishment and promotion date as 17 December 2017.
history.quote: ก่อตั้งเมื่อ : 17 ธันวาคม 2560

history.claim: Buildings in the old town area preserve traces of Sino-Portuguese or Sino-Takua Pa architecture related to the tin mining era.
history.quote: สถาปัตยกรรมชิโนโปรตุกีสอันทรงคุณค่า

timeline.title: Initial development of the town and Udomthara Road area
timeline.detail: Old town documents classify the period from 1827 to 1897 as the town's establishment and early development phase, with Udomthara Road being one of the first settlement areas.

timeline.title: Shophouses influenced by Penang and Singapore ports
timeline.detail: Sri Takua Pa Road features Straits Settlements colonial-influenced shophouses, which are linked to trade and the Chinese community in the port cities.

timeline.title: Takua Pa reached the peak of the mining era
timeline.detail: Documents explain that the town's prosperity peaked around 1957 before the mines closed and the commercial district stagnated.

timeline.title: Cultural walking street project began
timeline.detail: The TAT Phang Nga Office, Takua Pa Town Municipality, and the community started 'Takua Pa Old Town, Telling the Past'.

timeline.title: Registered and promoted as a market
timeline.detail: The Department of Internal Trade's registry lists 17 December 2017 as the date of the market's establishment and promotion.

timeline.title: Street opened during the green season with free Pho Thong buses
timeline.detail: The province and local partners expanded Sunday activities to stimulate off-season tourism and distribute income.

timeline.title: Merit-making and 9-Baht vegetarian food event
timeline.detail: The street serves as a venue for vegetarian food activities and carrying on old town community traditions, with over 200 participating shops according to news reports.

news.title: Merit-making and 9-Baht vegetarian food event in Takua Pa old town
news.summary: Vegetarian food activities and community traditions are held on the cultural street, with a large number of participants according to news reports.

news.title: Phang Nga opens Takua Pa walking street in the rainy season with free Pho Thong buses
news.summary: Green season activities were held every Sunday from 26 June to 28 August 2022 to distribute income to the community.

news.title: Takua Pa old town cultural street in the Must-See Market activity
news.summary: The Department of Internal Trade reported on activities promoting community market channels at the Takua Pa old town cultural street.

visit.best_time: Sunday evenings, especially during the tourist season from around November to April.

culture-street.address_line: Sri Takua Pa Road and Udomthara Road
